name: Get Range
description: Read a block of cells — 'B2:E10' — as a list of rows of plain values, for a sheet that is not a simple table with a header row.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet); if (!ws) return []; const plain = (v) => v && typeof v === 'object' ? ('result' in v ? v.result : Array.isArray(v.richText) ? v.richText.map((t) => t.text).join('') : 'text' in v ? v.text : v) : v; const [a, b] = String(range).split(':'); const from = ws.getCell(a), to = ws.getCell(b || a); const out = []; for (let r = from.row; r <= to.row; r++) { const line = []; for (let c = from.col; c <= to.col; c++) line.push(plain(ws.getCell(r, c).value)); out.push(line); } return out; })() }}"}]
